coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Liao 2024: every complexity result is derived in the text for K = 2 at fixed precision, and the constructions are given by circuits and figures; the paper runs no experiment. Liu 2023 (VQAs): Theorems 2 and 3 are quoted with their conditions and stay HIGH; Theorem 1's proof assumes one circuit form and a single copy, and the time figures are estimates under assumed gate times. Liu 2023 (tensor networks): Lemmas 2, 3, 4 and 7 stay HIGH; the bounds of Theorems 2 to 6 lose their precision symbol or their relations in the text layer and are read from page images, and Theorem 1's printed conditions contradict its proof. Liu 2023 (gradient descent): the supplement's symbols are lost, so its theorems are read from page images. Liu 2024 (quantum B+ tree): the math symbols are lost, every statement is cut before its bound, and the proofs are sketches. Exponents printed flat are not counted as lost symbols
